description: This file defines interfaces for code file parsing, directory scanning, file watching, and related data structures used in a code indexing service, including methods for processing code blocks, directory scanning, and batch processing events.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parses a code file into code blocks, returning a promise resolving to an array of CodeBlock objects.

methods.name: scanDirectory
methods.description: Scans a directory for code blocks, returning a promise with scan results including processed and skipped counts.

methods.name: updateBatchSegmentThreshold
methods.description: Updates the batch segment threshold value for directory scanning or file watching.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Processes a specified file and returns a promise with the processing result.
